gaps.sentence: The instructions were ___ (WRITE) in six languages.
gaps.explanation: Passive voice: were written — irregular participle of write.

gaps.sentence: He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: The charity relies entirely on voluntary ___ (DONATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Voluntary donations' — gifts of money given willingly.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DECIDE) to close the factory was announced yesterday.
The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is unknown.
gaps.explanation: 'Depth' — noun from deep (spelling change: deep → depth).

gaps.sentence: There's a growing ___ (AWARE) of mental health issues.
The village is ___ (ACCESS) only by boat.
gaps.explanation: 'Accessible' = easy to reach; the -ible spelling follows 'access'.
